summary.text: Marissa Tasker is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 148 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a member of the Maine School Administrative District 60 school board, representing Berwick.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Tasker said she has lived and volunteered in the Berwick community for more than three decades, including her current service on the school board.
She listed education as a priority, citing state funding for schools and concern about possible voucher systems, along with access to healthcare, mental health services and housing costs.
She said her primary objective is to serve on the education committee.
